name: phpMyAdmin 5.2 with MySQL 8.4 LTS
description: MySQL web admin with its own login, plus a ready MySQL 8.4 LTS database.

phpMyAdmin.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -e; n() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo $2 ;; *) echo $1 ;; esac; }; E=/etc/apache2/mods-enabled; N=$(ls $E/mpm_*.load 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$N" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -e $E/mpm_prefork.load ]; then echo "pma-start: $N Apache MPM modules enabled, keeping mpm_prefork only"; rm -f $E/mpm_*.load $E/mpm_*.conf; a2enmod -q mpm_prefork; fi; W=$(n "$PMA_APACHE_WORKERS" 10); if [ $W -lt 2 ]; then W=2; fi; if [ $W -gt 256 ]; then W=256; fi; A=/etc/apache2/conf-enabled/zz-railway.conf; echo "ServerTokens Prod" > $A; echo "ServerSignature Off" >> $A; echo "<IfModule mpm_prefork_module>" >> $A; echo "StartServers 2" >> $A; echo "MinSpareServers 1" >> $A; echo "MaxSpareServers 4" >> $A; echo "ServerLimit $W" >> $A; echo "MaxRequestWorkers $W" >> $A; echo "MaxConnectionsPerChild 500" >> $A; echo "</IfModule>" >> $A; I="${PHP_INI_DIR:-/usr/local/etc/php}/conf.d/zz-railway.ini"; echo "display_errors = Off" > $I; echo "log_errors = On" >> $I; echo "expose_php = Off" >> $I; echo "pma-start: Apache prefork MaxRequestWorkers $W, PMA_HOST ${PMA_HOST:-unset}:${PMA_PORT:-3306}, root login ${PMA_ALLOW_ROOT:-false}"; exec /docker-entrypoint.sh apache2-foreground' pma-start

PORT.description: Port Apache listens on; the public domain and the healthcheck use it.

PMA_HOST.description: MySQL/MariaDB host phpMyAdmin connects to (private network). Point it at another Railway database to manage that one.

PMA_ABSOLUTE_URI.description: Public URL of phpMyAdmin (keeps redirects on HTTPS).

PMA_ALLOW_ROOT.description: true allows the MySQL root account to log in through the web UI (needed for server-wide admin, or for Railway's MySQL template whose user is root).

PMA_APACHE_WORKERS.description: Maximum concurrent Apache/PHP workers (each up to MEMORY_LIMIT).

UPLOAD_LIMIT.description: Largest file the Import tab accepts (PHP upload and POST size).

MEMORY_LIMIT.description: PHP memory limit per request (large imports and exports).

HIDE_PHP_VERSION.description: Do not send the PHP version in HTTP headers.

PMA_USER_CONFIG_BASE64.description: Template hardening for phpMyAdmin (root login switch, no empty passwords, no free-text server field, failed logins logged). Base64 of services/phpmyadmin/config.user.inc.php; the image writes it at start.

MySQL.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -e; k() { v=$1; if [ $v -lt $2 ]; then v=$2; fi; if [ $v -gt $3 ]; then v=$3; fi; echo $v; }; n() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo $2 ;; *) echo $1 ;; esac; }; H=$(( $(n "$(grep -m 1 MemTotal /proc/meminfo | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 2)" 1048576) / 1024 )); L=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo max); M=$(( $(n "$L" $((H * 1048576))) / 1048576 )); if [ $M -gt $H ]; then M=$H; fi; B=$(k $(n "$MYSQL_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB" $(k $M 256 8192)) 256 4194304); P=$(k $(n "$MYSQL_BUFFER_POOL_MB" $(k $((B / 2)) 128 2097152)) 32 4194304); C=$(k $(n "$MYSQL_MAX_CONNECTIONS" $(k $((B / 8)) 100 500)) 10 100000); echo "mysql-start: budget ${B}MB (container ${M}MB, host ${H}MB), innodb_buffer_pool_size ${P}M, max_connections $C"; set -f; exec docker-entrypoint.sh mysqld --innodb-use-native-aio=0 --disable-log-bin --performance-schema=0 --innodb-buffer-pool-size=${P}M --max-connections=$C --character-set-server=utf8mb4 --collation-server=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci --max-allowed-packet=64M ${MYSQL_EXTRA_ARGS:-}' mysql-start

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password (generated). Set on the first start only.

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Database created on the first start.

MYSQL_USER.description: App user created on the first start with all privileges on MYSQL_DATABASE. Log in to phpMyAdmin with it.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: Password of MYSQL_USER (generated). Set on the first start only.

MYSQLUSER.description: MySQL user for the Railway Data panel.

MYSQLPASSWORD.description: Root password for the Railway Data panel.

MYSQLDATABASE.description: Default database for the Railway Data panel.

MYSQL_URL.description: Private connection URL (app user) for other services in this project.

MYSQL_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: Memory budget for sizing InnoDB (auto = container limit, capped at 8192).

MYSQL_BUFFER_POOL_MB.description: innodb_buffer_pool_size in MB (auto = half the budget).

MYSQL_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra mysqld options appended to the command line, e.g. --sql-mode=TRADITIONAL.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow MySQL to shut down cleanly.
